summary: Steep, narrow townhouse estate street with homes at the kerb throughout.
reasons: Townhouses within 10 m along the kerb

drivers.seclusion: Dense townhouse estate; homes sit right at the kerb along most of it. Only the first 40 m has bush opposite, but a house is close to the east.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane with kerb to fence and bank; no verge or pull-off wide enough for a van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residents-only loop; a highway runs beyond bush to the east.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along the lane; looks like a private complex road.

flags: Steep: about 7.4% mean, up to 27% max
Looks like a private estate road
Homes not mapped in OSM but clear in imagery
Gate 9 m from the end, with a way round
sun_shade: Mostly open to sun; bush shades the western side near the end.
cannot_judge: Whether the estate road is private
